title: ようこそ、バブリーランドへ

text_block_list.name: Maruzensky
text_block_list.text: Time to let loose and groove it! Woohoo!
Whoooa!
On our day off, we decide to visit Bubblyland, a pool resort Maruzensky had frequented ever since she was little.

text_block_list.name: Maruzensky
text_block_list.text: Phew! I've worked up a good sweat! Sorry about the holdup.

text_block_list.name: Maruzensky
text_block_list.text: Phew! I've worked up a good sweat! Sorry about the holdup.
From the retro facilities to the guests' old-fashioned costumes, everything looks like we've traveled back in time.

text_block_list.name: Maruzensky
text_block_list.text: Hm? Do the outfits catch your eye? You can rent one if you want!

text_block_list.name: Maruzensky
text_block_list.text: They've got shoulder-padded blazers, bodycon dresses, and nice baggy suits!

text_block_list.name: Maruzensky
text_block_list.text: There's even an option to get your hair done. You can get it crimped or styled like a bob. It's so hip!

text_block_list.name: Maruzensky
text_block_list.text: My first time here, I got up on stage with my mom and danced in a bodycon.

text_block_list.name: Maruzensky
text_block_list.text: I remember getting mad over how it would keep slipping since I wasn't quite big enough to fill it out yet.

text_block_list.name: Maruzensky
text_block_list.text: Hehe, talk about a blast from the past.

text_block_list.name: Maruzensky
text_block_list.text: Anyway, I think it should be starting right about now.
Ding, dong…

text_block_list.name: Announcer
text_block_list.text: "The all-you-can-eat tiramisu contest will be starting soon at the Bubbly Cafe. We hope to see you there."

text_block_list.name: Maruzensky
text_block_list.text: All right, let's stuff ourselves silly!

text_block_list.name: Maruzensky
text_block_list.text: Mm-mmm, that was delicious! But I sure can't pack down the sweets like I used to.

text_block_list.name: Maruzensky
text_block_list.text: You know, I actually won the contest when I was a kid.

text_block_list.name: Maruzensky
text_block_list.text: Yeah. ♪ Once, my competition got pretty close. I had to switch to beast mode.

text_block_list.name: Maruzensky
text_block_list.text: But it wasn't a problem since the sweets were all so good. I was able to keep eating and eating.

text_block_list.name: Maruzensky
text_block_list.text: Now that we've put those hunger pangs at bay, it's finally time to hit the pool. Let's make like a banana and split! ♪
She must really like it here. Watching her be this free-spirited puts a smile on my face.

text_block_list.name: Maruzensky
text_block_list.text: Wahoo! Come on! Keep your eyes ahead so you don't slip or hit something!

text_block_list.name: Maruzensky
text_block_list.text: Wahoo! Come on! Keep your eyes ahead so you don't slip or hit something!
Splash!

text_block_list.name: Maruzensky
text_block_list.text: Phew! That was fun! I just can't get enough of that speed!

text_block_list.name: Maruzensky
text_block_list.text: Lemme think… You know, I do remember riding the slide over and over after dancing with my mom.

text_block_list.name: Maruzensky
text_block_list.text: We were totally hooked. Haha, that sure takes me back.

text_block_list.name: Maruzensky
text_block_list.text: You're right about that. People often say we seem more like friends than family.

text_block_list.name: Maruzensky
text_block_list.text: …Now that I think about it, it's been a while since we came here together.
As she says this, Maruzensky's voice begins to soften just slightly.

text_block_list.name: Maruzensky
text_block_list.text: Actually, we haven't been talking very much recently. I wonder if my mom is doing okay…
It's rare to see Maruzensky feeling down. I make an impromptu suggestion.
choice_data_list: Let's send her a wonderful picture!
Let's buy her an amazing souvenir!

text_block_list.name: Maruzensky
text_block_list.text: Ooh, what a great idea! I'm sure she'll love seeing all the new things they've added here!

text_block_list.name: Maruzensky
text_block_list.text: Now that we've decided, let's go find us some wonderful locations!

text_block_list.name: Maruzensky
text_block_list.text: Oh gosh, look at this sweet ride! What a chick magnet, am I right? This'll make a rad photo spot!

text_block_list.name: Maruzensky
text_block_list.text: All right, here I go! Come get in the picture too!

text_block_list.name: Maruzensky
text_block_list.text: All right, here I go! Come get in the picture too!
Click!

text_block_list.name: Maruzensky
text_block_list.text: Bubbly!
Click!

text_block_list.name: Maruzensky
text_block_list.text: Let's get it popping tonight! ♪
Click!

text_block_list.name: Maruzensky
text_block_list.text: I think these turned out quite well! Our smiles look great. ♪

text_block_list.name: Maruzensky
text_block_list.text: I think these turned out quite well! Our smiles look great. ♪

text_block_list.name: Maruzensky
text_block_list.text: I hope this brings back good memories for my mom.
As Maruzensky flicks through the photos, a little smile appears on her face.
The next day, we discover Maruzensky had been holding her phone upside down for all the photos, but that's a story for another day.

text_block_list.name: Maruzensky
text_block_list.text: Sounds good! There's a lot of stuff here that my mom likes!

text_block_list.name: Maruzensky
text_block_list.text: Now that we've decided, let's hit the souvenir shop! ♪

text_block_list.name: Maruzensky
text_block_list.text: It's down to either this chain-handle bag or this leather bucket bag! Oh, but this brooch is really fetching too…

text_block_list.name: Maruzensky
text_block_list.text: They're even selling a bodycon set that comes with its very own fan! I'd love one for myself! Gosh, I'm totally stumped!

text_block_list.name: Maruzensky
text_block_list.text: …What do you think about going for something like this Bubbly manju? The silver dragees on top make it ever so sparkly!
We check several other places after that, but nothing we see seems to click.

text_block_list.name: Maruzensky
text_block_list.text: Hm, what do I do? I'm not sure what would make her really happy.

text_block_list.name: Maruzensky
text_block_list.text: …Wait, this song sounds so familiar. I've definitely heard it—

text_block_list.name: Maruzensky
text_block_list.text: Ah!

text_block_list.name: Maruzensky
text_block_list.text: Jeepers! My mom used to play this song in the car all the time!

text_block_list.name: Maruzensky
text_block_list.text: But the tape gave out and we haven't listened to it since.

text_block_list.name: Maruzensky
text_block_list.text: That's it! Why not give her this song as a present? That record shop over there should have it in stock!
We hurry over, and sure enough, find the cassette. The clerk gift wraps it for us, and then a few days later…

text_block_list.name: Maruzensky
text_block_list.text: Hehe. Mom really liked it. She's been listening to it nonstop.
Maruzensky smiles brightly as she shares the good news with me.
